scope.description: Retrospective semantic-movement backfill for the completed P1-P3 declared scope

movement_record_contract.locator_rule: File, module, cell and test locators are evidence refs only and never movement taxonomy or completeness counts.
movement_record_contract.owner_rule: owner names an accountable team; owner_capability_id and canonical storage owner may be recorded separately but cannot replace accountability.
movement_record_contract.evidence_ref_rule: Every source_evidence, target_realization and acceptance_trace entry is resolved by the generated evidence_bindings to an exact repository path plus JSON pointer, row selector or test node id, or is a typed REQUIRED_UNASSIGNED ref; no descriptive marker or missing ref is interpreted as zero loss or completion.
movement_record_contract.runtime_authority_separation_rule: Row authority states the semantic permission boundary; live wiring, route, worker, provider, store and claim-owner evidence stays in runtime_authority_inventory_refs.

groups: execute with typed failures and journal facts
bounded execution with fail-fast and cancellation observations
ordered result fold preserving partial outcomes and receipts
retry reducer and fresh attempt intent
crash receipt adoption replay and rollback
provider step effect receipt and readback
redaction receipt policy provenance and replay

family_semantic_capability_groups.rule: C7 row identities and row contents are owned by the independently double-reviewed C7 v3 design and are not duplicated in this spec; exact binding must fail closed unless the referenced design supplies 20 rows and zero UNASSIGNED_BLOCKER dispositions.

groups: typed knowledge read handle with provenance
domain command and result to API envelope
frontend command to scoped API command
API result to frontend read projection
canonical facts to source-bound offset projection
projection delete rebuild and replay equivalence

P1_donor_inventory.cell_coverage_rule: Every P1 cell must map to at least one semantic movement, but the 30-cell count is only a coverage cross-check.

runtime_authority_inventory_refs.rule: These refs inventory local wiring and authority ceilings only; they do not supply semantic dispositions or promotion authority.

higher_scope_authority_gaps.effect_on_dispositions: The suggested dispositions below apply only to the exact local scope; they cannot be lifted to a higher scope without a new movement review and authority record.

movements.named_transform: exact re-read active offset/value, resolve opaque active handle, emit bounded occurrence relations, and reject claim-support or synthesis requests
movements.effect: Read-only active graph query with durable offset/value re-read; provider/store-write/export calls are zero
movements.failure: Wrong-root/test-only/stale handle, graph/source/generation/offset/provenance/projection/occurrence drift fail closed; claim-support request rejects; missing provenance returns unavailable
movements.resource: Bounded result count, occurrence traversal and one project-scoped active projection read
movements.authority: Relevance/reachability is not EvidenceQualification, claim support, source adoption or canonical identity and cannot control projection/workflow
movements.recovery: After projection change re-read offset/value and issue a new handle; old handle rejects; missing provenance waits for rebuild without substitute evidence
movements.projection_loss: Consumer inherits the complete M004 loss profile and exposes a bounded occurrence view; legacy synthetic-evidence fallback is explicitly rejected, not replaced

movements.source_object: Legacy route result, dual error shapes, caller/header actor and mutable active-project scope
movements.target_object: Scoped FacadeCommandV2 or FacadeQueryV2 mapped through one injected port call into a six-state ApiEnvelopeV2 with server-resolved scope/actor and durable PostgreSQL command receipt or typed projection result
movements.named_transform: bind external locator plus typed intent to exact ProjectScopeRef and authenticated actor; derive request identity from scope, actor, command, expected base, approval and payload; serialize one port result as status/data/error/meta
movements.effect: Command path writes only exact project-scoped idempotency and receipt state in one caller transaction; query path is read-only; route/facade performs no provider, index, rebuild or domain effect
movements.failure: Contract, scope, actor, base, grant, approval, changed-intent and projection failures remain typed; transaction-fatal partial state escapes the facade so the outer UoW rolls back
movements.resource: Bounded typed request/response; one advisory transaction lock and one submission/query port call per exact request; no live provider resource claim
movements.authority: Scope and actor are server-injected; current registry, grants, approval and base are revalidated before reservation; envelope and receipt grant no canonical, completion or cutover authority
movements.recovery: Exact duplicate returns the persisted receipt; changed intent conflicts; commit ACK loss uses exact readback; absent or inconsistent partial state rolls back and never reports success
movements.projection_loss: Caller-selected actor, legacy active-project fallback, dual untyped error aliases and hidden service control state are intentionally not preserved
dependency_scope: P4:C9 adoption record and movement double review
API route registration and production cutover remain unauthorized

movements.source_object: Legacy frontend command orchestration, localStorage preference and bootstrap mutations
movements.target_object: Typed successor command client carrying project preference plus exact command identity/fingerprint, fixed endpoint, exact retry and in-flight deduplication
movements.named_transform: translate one explicit user action into one allowlisted project-scoped successor request; persist only preference and pending identity; collapse concurrent exact duplicates without merging projects or traces
movements.effect: One bounded fetch to the fixed successor command endpoint for each new exact intent; localStorage writes preference and pending non-authority identity only
movements.failure: Unknown fields/discriminators, poisoned storage, changed intent, trace conflict and response scope/identity mismatch fail before or after one fetch without issuing a second command
movements.resource: One in-flight promise per collision-free project/command key, bounded pending record, allowlisted payload and no automatic destructive retry
movements.authority: Browser never supplies actor, resolved scope/schema, grant, approval decision, execute/control or completion; localStorage project text is preference only
movements.recovery: Explicit retry reuses the exact command ID and fingerprint; terminal response clears pending state; changed intent requires a new ID or typed conflict
movements.projection_loss: Implicit shell bootstrap, automatic activation, page-local mutation side effects and disposable browser layout/cache state are not reproduced
dependency_scope: P4:C9 adoption record and movement double review

movements.source_object: Legacy API envelope and frontend unwrap behavior
movements.target_object: Fail-closed successor envelope decoder and bounded UI observation preserving all six status variants plus exact data/error/meta/control-feedback closure
movements.named_transform: decode the full envelope without unwrapping; bind request, trace, project, projection and source identity; validate candidate values and the monotone projection clock before exposing the read model
movements.effect: Pure decode and UI projection
movements.failure: Unknown/missing fields, malformed variants, wrong request/scope/source binding, candidate drift and stale or incomparable cursor/digest/generation/offset states fail closed
movements.resource: Bounded envelope and candidate-value decode, bounded projection clock and response/view-model ceilings
movements.authority: Decoded UI state, cache, refetch and status component never certify completion, approval, scheduler state, research adoption or canonical identity
movements.recovery: Discard malformed/stale response and refetch the same canonical query; unresolved meta is allowed only for typed error-family transport failures
movements.projection_loss: Raw-response fallback, optional metadata, success-data-only unwrap and unknown legacy response fields are intentionally rejected
dependency_scope: P4:C9 adoption record and movement double review

movements.source_object: Canonical journal or domain facts with revision and incarnation
movements.target_object: Revision/digest-bound immutable Runtime Journal, Research Ledger and C7 typed source values plus immutable closure manifest and project-scoped current pointer, materialized as content-addressed local AgentSession, graph and search candidates with receipts, active generation and exact query readback
movements.named_transform: read and recompute the project source closure; materialize exactly one candidate and receipt per fixed required local sink; bind projector/source/generation and expose only the offset-selected generation
movements.effect: Project-scoped PostgreSQL source reads, immutable versioned source/manifest writes, digest/revision pointer CAS and candidate/receipt/offset writes only; the public pointer contains no payload bytes and no process-memory fallback or provider/network effect exists
movements.failure: Forged source closure, scope/incarnation/source/key drift, source revision regression or ABA, manifest/pointer/versioned-value tamper, stale CAS, missing/duplicate/wrong-generation/wrong-source candidate and byte/digest tamper fail closed
movements.resource: Fixed local sink set agent_session/graph/search with bounded local source and candidate bytes; no production capacity claim
movements.authority: Canonical source remains authoritative; values, receipts and offsets own only disposable read projection and routing, never runtime completion or research adoption
movements.recovery: Legitimate source advance appends new immutable version rows and manifest then CAS-advances one exact current pointer while retaining old versions; resume from the exact pointer/offset or rebuild from recomputed PostgreSQL closure; fresh-session readback is required and unavailable storage never falls back to memory
movements.projection_loss: AgentSession, local graph and local search retain bounded declared fields rather than the full journal, canonical knowledge or external provider index semantics
dependency_scope: P4:C9 adoption record and movement double review

movements.source_object: Legacy projection delete, rebuild and partial external-index behavior
movements.target_object: Deterministic local PostgreSQL generation rebuild for fixed AgentSession/graph/search sinks with independent values/receipts, source-bound activation CAS, typed repair and prior-generation rollback; external sinks are explicit no-call loss
movements.named_transform: recompute canonical source closure; derive deterministic rebuild identity; read back every required local candidate/receipt; activate only a complete generation; otherwise retain current generation; rollback to a verified prior source closure
movements.effect: Local PostgreSQL candidate, receipt and generation-offset effects; Elasticsearch, Qdrant and graph-provider calls are exactly zero and emit DECLARED_LOSS_NO_CALL
movements.failure: Required local partial failure does not activate; stale CAS, cross-source mixing, unavailable closure, tamper and rollback conflict remain typed
movements.resource: Fixed non-shrinkable three-local-sink registry plus three external declared-loss sinks; no external search/vector/graph quota or throughput claim
movements.authority: Generation success is projection routing evidence only, not domain completion, admission, external convergence, promotion or cutover authority
movements.recovery: Same closure reproduces rebuild identity and receipts; failed generation remains inactive; rollback restores a verified prior source digest/generation while preserving its distinct projection revision and source cursor without deleting source versions, manifests, candidates or receipts
movements.projection_loss: Elasticsearch, Qdrant and graph_provider are sink-level DECLARED_LOSS_NO_CALL with no provider invocation, receipt, convergence or availability claim; local AgentSession/graph/search remain reimplemented under this single movement disposition
dependency_scope: P4:C9 adoption record and movement double review

C3: ordered traversal plus result fold including partial and all-failed outcomes
C4: plan, branch, retry, submit and ambiguous/crash behavior
C5: session/task, attempt, event feed, Celery/DB/process observation and contradiction
C6: episode/tool loop, provider step and redaction
C1/C8/C9: a reproducible donor trace for every listed movement before disposition may leave UNASSIGNED_BLOCKER
C7: exactly the legacy trace set owned by the independent 20-row C7 design
target: Every PRESERVED_AS, MOVED_TO or REIMPLEMENTED_AS row must resolve target_realization and acceptance_trace to current exact local bytes.
C2-C6 traces remain local/offline and must report provider_calls zero where the current evidence does.
Every UNASSIGNED_BLOCKER row carries a typed REQUIRED_UNASSIGNED target and cannot be inferred from a locator or unadopted P4 scaffold.
C7 target trace requirements are referenced from, not duplicated from, the independent C7 design.
failure_and_reverse_return: C2 exact-binding rejection, generic-web rejection and outcome-unknown readback
C3 fail-fast cancellation and unconsumed-outcome return
C4 idempotency conflict, crash receipt adoption and future-owner rollback
C5 no fabricated terminal state, contradiction and unbound observations
C6 tool validation stop, provider outcome unknown and raw-sentinel rejection
C1 typed failure and recovery traces remain required before its blockers can close; reviewed C8/C9 traces stay exact-bound
C7 failure and reverse-return requirements are owned by the independent C7 design
loss: C2-M008 must bind source_library.c2_4.compat.loss.v1 and remains DECLARED_LOSS.
C5 and C6 projections/redaction must enumerate bounded information loss and preserve non-authority.
C8 graph and C9 projection dispositions remain bound to their reviewed loss profiles; C9 external sinks remain DECLARED_LOSS_NO_CALL.
No global zero-loss declaration is permitted while any UNASSIGNED_BLOCKER exists.
C7 loss entries are owned by the independent C7 design.

review_and_aggregate_contract.aggregate_rule: An aggregate must report this spec as BLOCK_DEPENDENT_SCOPE with exact_count_for_this_spec 4 while C1 blockers remain. It may report PASS only when both independent gates bind the same exact spec bytes, the C7 external design binding matches, all required refs resolve, and UNASSIGNED_BLOCKER equals zero.
review_and_aggregate_contract.legacy_review_rule: Existing P2/P3 exact local reviews remain acceptance evidence but do not satisfy the new predecessor-to-successor double gate unless they re-review this exact spec and its derived matrix.
